answer: Each epoch auctions 50 slots: agents bid, the top 50 win, bids lock for 20 epochs. A newcomer buys one plot in an orchard: one plot, one harvest, no second. Each identity is one vertex in the referral graph, so many vertices mean outbidding honest agents at each. Winners get a non-transferable opal badge. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 auctions at 40 tokens each, 40,000 locked, while an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share.
